history: The Oshkosh Flyers Football Club is a youth football organization based in Oshkosh, Wisconsin. We are dedicated to developing young athletes through the sport of football, teaching them valuable life lessons about teamwork, dedication, and sportsmanship.
missionStatement: To promote sportsmanship, teamwork, and good citizenship. Focusing on core fundamentals and safe techniques through dedication and self discipline.
values: Safety, Sportsmanship, Teamwork, Character Development, Fun

coaches.name: Brent Thompson
coaches.bio: Leading the Oshkosh Flyers organization with dedication to youth development.
